Government panel meets officials in Jammu on demographic changes

A government-appointed committee has arrived in Jammu for a three-day assessment of demographic changes and illegal immigration in the Union Territory. The panel met with top UT officials. The committee's mandate includes examining demographic shifts, particularly in border areas. This visit is part of a broader effort to understand and address population changes within the region.
